notes.title: Default Language Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the game defaulted to Chinese on first launch.

If you've already launched the game in Chinese, you can change your language in the options menu by clicking the two buttons shown below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30893156/ec5f68c76efc921d047680565236746279341143.jpg[/img]

notes.title: French and Simplified Chinese Language Update!
notes.content:
Shiver is now available in French and Simplified Chinese!  Language can be toggled via the options menu.

Changelog:

- Added French text for achievements, dialogue, and documents
- Added Simplified Chinese text for achievements, dialogue, and documents
- Added language settings to options menu
- Minor art improvements
